title: DUMB Repopulation
subtitle: Test your understanding of DUMB Repopulation — how cloned children raised in Deep Underground Military Bases restock a cleared surface, and how genetic recombination conceals that artificial origin within a single generation.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: DUMB repopulation restocks a cleared surface with cloned children raised underground for a 3-to-4-year staging period. Genetic recombination then conceals the artificial origin of the population within a single generation, while handlers who provide food and shelter secure acceptance of installed social and historical narratives.

questions.question: What is the primary function of DUMB repopulation following a surface reset?

options.label: A
options.text: The primary function is the scientific study of how human bodies adapt to long-term underground living inside deep military bases.
options.rationale: The protocol cultivates cloned children underground and then deploys them to restock depopulated regions. It is not a research study of underground adaptation.

options.label: B
options.text: The primary function is the preservation of elite biological lineages through long subterranean isolation after the surface has been cleared.
options.rationale: DUMB repopulation is the subterranean cultivation and surface deployment of manufactured human clones to restock the physical plane following a surface reset.

options.label: C
options.text: DUMB repopulation is the subterranean cultivation and surface deployment of manufactured human clones to restock the physical plane.
options.rationale: Operating out of Deep Underground Military Bases, this protocol bridges catastrophic depopulation and a new human population overlay.

options.label: D
options.text: The primary function is the transition of human consciousness into synthetic AI humanoid facsimiles that replace biological people on the surface.
options.rationale: Synthetic AI humanoid facsimiles belong to the specialized workforce that raises cloned cohorts underground. DUMB repopulation restocks the physical plane with manufactured human clones.

questions.hint: Focus on the immediate need for a new population after a catastrophic event.

questions.question: Which system was utilized during the reset of circa 1900 to distribute cloned children into cities?

options.label: A
options.text: Orphan Trains are the surface distribution system utilized during resets to transport young cloned children into repurposed towns and cities.
options.rationale: During the reset of circa 1900, this mass transit operation was carried out using Orphan Trains.

options.label: B
options.text: A custodial evacuation of survivors from regions about to be reset is the system that delivered the new cloned children into cities.
options.rationale: Survivors from prior regions were allowed to evacuate before their own areas were reset. Orphan Trains transported the young cloned children.

options.label: C
options.text: The subterranean staging network is the surface transport system that carried cloned children into towns and cities circa 1900.
options.rationale: The Subterranean Staging Period is the 3-to-4-year window when cloned children are raised underground. Orphan Trains moved them on the surface.

options.label: D
options.text: Surviving Tartarian stone architecture is the transport system that moved cloned children from the bases into repurposed cities.
options.rationale: Tartarian stone architecture is the housing the children occupied. Orphan Trains were the surface distribution system.

questions.hint: Consider the historical name given to the mass transit of children into new towns.

questions.question: How many duplicate copies are produced for every genetic template in a subterranean batch?

options.label: A
options.text: Every genetic template selected for underground cloning is produced as 15 to 20 duplicate copies before surface deployment, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The stated batch is 5 to 10 duplicate copies produced for each template, not 15 to 20.

options.label: B
options.text: Every genetic template selected for underground cloning is produced as only 1 to 2 duplicate copies before surface deployment.
options.rationale: Each template selected for underground cloning is created in batches of 5 to 10 duplicate copies, not 1 to 2.

options.label: C
options.text: Every child deployed circa 1900 originated as a clone grown in underground bases, with 5 to 10 duplicate copies produced for each template.
options.rationale: Subterranean batch production manufactures 5 to 10 duplicate copies of each selected template.

options.label: D
options.text: Every genetic template selected for underground cloning is produced as 50 to 100 duplicate copies before surface deployment, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Batch production yields 5 to 10 duplicate copies produced for each template, not 50 to 100.

questions.hint: Think of a small numerical range between five and ten.

questions.question: What biological process ensures that the artificial origin of a population is hidden within one generation?

options.label: A
options.text: Synthetic genetic splicing after surface deployment is the process that hides the artificial origin within one generation, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Concealment happens when offspring become fully unique biological individuals through sexual reproduction and genetic recombination.

options.label: B
options.text: Atavistic trait suppression is the process that hides the artificial origin of the cloned population within one generation, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The biological mechanism accounts for atavistic traits, genetic throwbacks, and temporal doppelgängers. It does not suppress them.

options.label: C
options.text: Genetic recombination ensures that within a single generation, the artificial, cloned origin of the population is hidden behind standard biological inheritance patterns.
options.rationale: Each clone parent passes on 50% of their DNA, and genetic recombination mixes the genetic material randomly.

options.label: D
options.text: Subterranean batch production is the process that hides the artificial origin of the population within a single generation, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Batch production creates the initial wave of exact clones. Genetic recombination hides that origin in the next generation.

questions.hint: Recall what happens when DNA from two cloned parents mixes during reproduction.

questions.question: What is the typical duration of the Subterranean Staging Period for cloned children?

options.label: A
options.text: The Subterranean Staging Period is a 7-to-10-year developmental window during which cloned children are raised underground.
options.rationale: The holding period ends at ages 3-4. It is the 3-to-4-year developmental window, not 7 to 10 years.

options.label: B
options.text: The Subterranean Staging Period is a 1-to-2-year developmental window during which cloned children are raised underground.
options.rationale: The developmental window is 3 to 4 years, the time required for crews to clean up wreckage, carnage, and structural devastation.

options.label: C
options.text: The Subterranean Staging Period is the 3-to-4-year developmental window during which cloned children are raised underground.
options.rationale: Infants are maintained underground until reaching ages 3-4 while custodial crews clear surface carnage and devastation.

options.label: D
options.text: The Subterranean Staging Period is an 18-to-21-year developmental window during which cloned children are raised underground.
options.rationale: Cloned children are maintained underground until ages 3-4, then transferred above ground for distribution.

questions.hint: Look for a developmental window where a child is walking and talking but still very young.

questions.question: Which group makes up the specialized workforce tasked with raising cloned cohorts in the DUMBs?

options.label: A
options.text: Natural-born children from untouched remote regions make up the specialized workforce that raises the cloned cohorts underground, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Cloned cohorts are raised by 33rd-degree Freemasons, human clones retained from preceding resets, and synthetic AI humanoid facsimiles.

options.label: B
options.text: A specialized workforce consisting of 33rd-degree Freemasons, human clones retained from preceding resets, and synthetic AI humanoid facsimiles.
options.rationale: Those compromised personnel supervise cloned children in total isolation from true history inside the subterranean facilities.

options.label: C
options.text: Independent scientific researchers preserved from preceding surface civilisations make up the workforce that raises the cloned cohorts.
options.rationale: The facilities are staffed by 33rd-degree Freemasons who traded alignment for survival, surviving clones from prior reset cycles, and AI humanoid facsimiles.

options.label: D
options.text: Surface survivors who volunteered for subterranean duty make up the specialized workforce that raises the cloned cohorts, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Surface survivors meet the children above ground as foster parents and community figures. The underground workforce is Freemasons, retained clones, and AI facsimiles.

questions.hint: Consider the mix of high-level secret societies and synthetic technology mentioned.

questions.question: What is a Temporal Doppelgänger in the context of DUMB repopulation?

options.label: A
options.text: A Temporal Doppelgänger is an AI humanoid facsimile built to mimic one deceased historical figure on the cleared surface, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: AI humanoid facsimiles are part of the underground workforce. A Temporal Doppelgänger is a historical lookalike from aligned facial genes or clone templates.

options.label: B
options.text: A Temporal Doppelgänger is a clone transported through time by advanced technology inside the underground bases, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: The phenomenon occurs when facial genes or clone templates align across generations or eras within a lineage.

options.label: C
options.text: A Temporal Doppelgänger is a custodial worker who oversees several generations of cloned children inside the underground bases, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: The term names a historical lookalike phenomenon, not a member of the specialized workforce.

options.label: D
options.text: A Temporal Doppelgänger is a historical lookalike phenomenon occurring when facial genes or clone templates align across generations or eras within a lineage.
options.rationale: Identical facial configurations or structural features reappear across distant historical eras or generational lines.

questions.hint: Think about how fixed genetic templates might lead to people looking identical in different centuries.

questions.question: Why are incoming cloned populations placed into surviving Tartarian stone architecture?

options.label: A
options.text: Scrubbed Tartarian architecture is prepared by custodians to house incoming cloned cohorts under artificial narratives.
options.rationale: Incoming cloned populations are placed directly into surviving Tartarian stone architecture, which is re-labeled and repurposed as conventional housing, schools, and civic buildings.

options.label: B
options.text: Incoming cloned populations are placed there because stone structures are more resistant to the next surface reset.
options.rationale: Surviving Tartarian stone architecture is re-labeled and repurposed as conventional housing, schools, and civic buildings.

options.label: C
options.text: Incoming cloned populations are placed there because clones are biologically incapable of constructing new surface buildings.
options.rationale: The placement uses surviving Tartarian stone architecture that custodians re-label as conventional housing, schools, and civic buildings.

options.label: D
options.text: Incoming cloned populations are placed there so custodians can study ancient acoustics on cloned psychological development.
options.rationale: The architecture is prepared by custodians to house incoming cloned cohorts under artificial narratives.

questions.hint: Consider the logistical efficiency of using pre-existing, durable buildings.

questions.question: How does the protocol utilize the law of Free Will to secure cooperation from the clones?

options.label: A
options.text: Custodians let the cloned cohorts vote on which historical narratives they will follow after they reach the surface.
options.rationale: The young clones accept the provided historical and civic explanations without resistance. The narratives are not chosen by vote.

options.label: B
options.text: Custodians secure consent by presenting surface handlers as compassionate rescuers who saved the children from disaster.
options.rationale: Because the incoming population willingly accepts assistance, consent to the artificial reality and its constraints becomes legally and operationally established within the field.

options.label: C
options.text: Custodians require every clone to sign a legal contract at the moment the cohort emerges from the underground bases.
options.rationale: Consent is established when the incoming population willingly accepts assistance from handlers, not by signed contracts.

options.label: D
options.text: Custodians inform the clones of their manufactured origin and then allow each child to choose a separate destiny.
options.rationale: Cloned children are raised in total isolation from true history and possess zero awareness of the nature of their creation.

questions.hint: Think about how a child would react to someone offering them food and safety after a disaster.

questions.question: What is the strategic implication of erasing generational memory through DUMB repopulation?

options.label: A
options.text: Erasing generational memory lets custodians build a society freed from the trauma of the surface reset.
options.rationale: The strategic result is that custodians wipe out historical continuity and past civilisational memory.

options.label: B
options.text: Custodians successfully wipe out historical continuity and past civilisational memory.
options.rationale: The surface plane is stocked with underground-reared clones who have no knowledge of prior events.

options.label: C
options.text: Erasing generational memory prevents clones from developing genetic mutations that would store memory in the body.
options.rationale: Memory is wiped by stocking the surface with underground-reared clones who have no knowledge of prior events.

options.label: D
options.text: Erasing generational memory makes the new population more physically resilient to conditions on the cleared surface.
options.rationale: The implication is the wipeout of historical continuity and past civilisational memory, not a gain in physical resilience.

questions.hint: Consider what happens to the knowledge of the old world when a new population knows nothing of it.

questions.question: True or False: Clones remain genetically identical to their parents indefinitely throughout the reset cycle.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The initial repopulating wave consists entirely of exact clones, but their offspring do not remain identical copies.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Although the initial repopulating wave consists entirely of exact clones, their offspring become fully unique biological individuals through sexual reproduction.

questions.hint: Recall the effect of the transition from cloning to natural reproduction.

questions.question: What role do surviving residents from prior regions play in the repopulation process?

options.label: A
options.text: Surviving residents from prior regions are the primary genetic donors for the next subterranean batch of clones, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Templates are cloned in batches of 5 to 10. Survivors from prior regions occupied repurposed locations and integrated the children.

options.label: B
options.text: These existing residents acted as foster parents and community figures to integrate the children into the new societal narrative.
options.rationale: They were survivors from prior regions who had been allowed to evacuate before their own areas were reset.

options.label: C
options.text: Surviving residents from prior regions act as the laborers who clean up the wreckage, carnage, and structural devastation.
options.rationale: Custodial crews clean up the wreckage. Existing residents acted as foster parents and community figures for the cloned children.

options.label: D
options.text: Surviving residents from prior regions are placed in cryostasis underground until the next surface reset cycle begins.
options.rationale: These existing residents occupied repurposed locations and met the cloned children on the surface as foster parents and community figures.

questions.hint: Think about who greets the children when they arrive in repurposed cities.

questions.question: Which of the following is considered a Repurposed Location in the DUMB protocol?

options.label: A
options.text: Repurposed Locations are scrubbed Tartarian architecture and urban environments prepared by custodians to house incoming cloned cohorts under artificial narratives.
options.rationale: That surviving Tartarian stone architecture is re-labeled and repurposed as conventional housing, schools, and civic buildings.

options.label: B
options.text: Repurposed Locations are newly constructed suburban developments built for the cloned cohorts after the reset of circa 1900, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Incoming cohorts occupy surviving stone structures from the Tartarian era that custodians scrub and re-label.

options.label: C
options.text: Repurposed Locations are mobile subterranean facilities that travel between Deep Underground Military Bases with each cohort, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: Repurposed Locations are scrubbed Tartarian architecture and urban environments on the surface.

options.label: D
options.text: Repurposed Locations are temporary tent cities erected for cloned children while custodial crews finish cleaning the surface, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Repurposed Locations are scrubbed Tartarian architecture and urban environments, not temporary tent cities.

questions.hint: Focus on the type of buildings clones occupy once they leave the underground bases.

questions.question: What does deploying cloned cohorts provide across the simulation field?

options.label: A
options.text: Deploying cloned cohorts provides a concentration of 33rd-degree Freemasons dense enough to staff every surface city, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: 33rd-degree Freemasons are part of the underground workforce. Deployed cohorts provide the baseline physical population on the surface.

options.label: B
options.text: Deploying cloned cohorts provides a counted remainder of non-cloned humans who are allowed to survive the reset, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: The deployment provides the baseline physical population necessary to sustain societal structures and maintain Non-Player Character density.

options.label: C
options.text: Deploying cloned cohorts provides the baseline physical population necessary to sustain societal structures and maintain Non-Player Character density.
options.rationale: That baseline population sustains societal structures and maintains Non-Player Character (NPC) density across the simulation field.

options.label: D
options.text: Deploying cloned cohorts provides the number of AI humanoid facsimiles required to manage the underground bases, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: AI humanoid facsimiles are part of the subterranean staff. The deployed cohorts supply the baseline physical population on the surface.

questions.hint: Think of the total number of people required to make a city feel real or functional.

questions.question: What is the relationship between DUMB repopulation and surface resets?

options.label: A
options.text: Surface resets are caused by the overpopulation of Deep Underground Military Bases before any cohort is released.
options.rationale: The protocol follows surface depopulation and supplies a replacement human population to inhabit cleared surface domains.

options.label: B
options.text: DUMB repopulation and surface resets are unrelated processes that never operate in the same cycle.
options.rationale: DUMB repopulation is the essential recovery mechanism following surface depopulation.

options.label: C
options.text: DUMB repopulation serves as the essential recovery mechanism following surface depopulation.
options.rationale: It rapidly supplies a replacement human population to inhabit cleared surface domains.

options.label: D
options.text: DUMB repopulation is the preventative measure that stops surface resets from occurring on the physical plane.
options.rationale: DUMB repopulation serves as the essential recovery mechanism following surface depopulation.

questions.hint: Consider the order of events: first the destruction, then the replenishment.

questions.question: True or False: The use of Orphan Trains was a one-time experiment that failed to distribute the population effectively.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Orphan Trains were the surface distribution system for the reset of circa 1900, not a failed experiment.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: During the reset of circa 1900, this mass transit operation was carried out using Orphan Trains. These transport networks moved thousands of young cloned children into repurposed cities, towns, and suburban settlements.

questions.hint: Reflect on how thousands of young children were moved into repurposed cities.

questions.question: What prevents scientific detection of the artificial repopulation cycle after one generation?

options.label: A
options.text: Scientific detection is prevented because AI humanoid facsimiles falsify every genetic testing record after the cohort is released, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: The masking is genetic recombination, which hides the artificial, cloned origin behind standard biological inheritance patterns.

options.label: B
options.text: Scientific detection is prevented because the clones have no DNA and therefore cannot be tested by any later generation, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Clone parents pass on DNA. Genetic recombination mixes that material so offspring are completely unique genetic individuals rather than clones.

options.label: C
options.text: Scientific detection is prevented because every scientific instrument is destroyed during the surface reset and never replaced, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Detection is prevented because the cloned origin is hidden behind standard biological inheritance patterns within a single generation.

options.label: D
options.text: Genetic recombination hides that origin behind standard biological inheritance patterns, preventing scientific detection of the artificial repopulation cycle.
options.rationale: Within a single generation, the artificial, cloned origin of the population is hidden behind standard biological inheritance patterns.

questions.hint: Think about what happens to the identikit nature of clones once they have children of their own.

questions.question: Why is it necessary to wait 3 to 4 years before deploying cloned children to the surface?

options.label: A
options.text: The holding period requires several years for custodial crews to clean up the wreckage, carnage, and structural devastation left behind by the reset.
options.rationale: Infants remain underground until ages 3-4 while that surface cleanup is completed.

options.label: B
options.text: The wait is necessary so the children develop enough strength to perform manual labor as soon as they arrive, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: The children are distributed into repurposed settlements and met by foster parents. The delay is for surface cleanup, not immediate labor.

options.label: C
options.text: The wait is necessary so radiation levels left by the reset can fall to a range that is safe for cloned children, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: The delay is surface logistics. Crews clean up the wreckage, carnage, and structural devastation left behind by the reset.

options.label: D
options.text: The wait is necessary so the children can complete basic integration training with the AI humanoid facsimiles, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: The holding period is dictated by surface logistics: custodial crews need several years to clean up wreckage, carnage, and structural devastation.

questions.hint: Think about the state of the world immediately after a catastrophic reset.

questions.question: Which term describes a trait that reappears across generations, potentially hinting at a clonal origin?

options.label: A
options.text: The term for a trait that reappears across generations and hints at a clonal origin is Synthetic Echo.
options.rationale: The biological mechanism accounts for atavistic traits, genetic throwbacks, and temporal doppelgängers.

options.label: B
options.text: This biological mechanism accounts for atavistic traits, genetic throwbacks, and temporal doppelgängers.
options.rationale: Identical facial configurations or structural features reappear across distant historical eras or generational lines.

options.label: C
options.text: The term for a trait that reappears across generations and hints at a clonal origin is Narrative Inoculation.
options.rationale: Narrative inoculation is the unquestioned acceptance of installed cultural frameworks. Atavistic traits are the biological reappearance.

options.label: D
options.text: The term for a trait that reappears across generations and hints at a clonal origin is Batch Congruence.
options.rationale: Batch production makes 5 to 10 duplicate copies. Reappearing traits are atavistic traits, genetic throwbacks, and temporal doppelgängers.

questions.hint: Look for a term often used in biology to describe the reappearance of ancestral features.

questions.question: What is the primary psychological effect of greeting young clones with food and shelter upon arrival?

options.label: A
options.text: Food and shelter induce immediate trauma that makes the arriving cloned children easy to manipulate afterward, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The children accept the provided historical and civic explanations without resistance because the handlers appear benevolent.

options.label: B
options.text: Young clones accept the provided historical and civic explanations without resistance when handlers provide food and shelter.
options.rationale: Seemingly benevolent handlers secure immediate, uncritical acceptance of installed social and historical narratives.

options.label: C
options.text: Food and shelter trigger an instinctual memory of life inside the Deep Underground Military Bases, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: The cloned children are raised in total isolation from true history and possess zero awareness of the nature of their creation.

options.label: D
options.text: Food and shelter encourage the children to question why they were separated from families they remember underground.
options.rationale: The benevolent greeting produces acceptance without resistance, not questions about a remembered family.

questions.hint: Consider how gratitude affects willingness to believe what they are told.

questions.question: What happens to the generational memory of previous civilisations during the repopulation process?

options.label: A
options.text: Generational memory of previous civilisations is archived in underground libraries so the clones can study it later, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The children are raised in total isolation from true history so custodians wipe out historical continuity and past civilisational memory.

options.label: B
options.text: Generational memory of previous civilisations is naturally preserved through a biological link from the children to the clone templates.
options.rationale: Genetic material is passed on, but the clones are raised in total isolation from true history and have no knowledge of prior events.

options.label: C
options.text: Generational memory of previous civilisations is transferred into the AI humanoid facsimiles for permanent safekeeping.
options.rationale: The surface is stocked with underground-reared clones who have no knowledge of prior events, which wipes out historical continuity.

options.label: D
options.text: Custodians wipe out that memory by stocking the surface plane with underground-reared clones who have no knowledge of prior events.
options.rationale: Those cohorts successfully wipe out historical continuity and past civilisational memory.

questions.hint: Focus on the result of raising children in total isolation from true history.

questions.question: In the DUMB workforce, who are the human clones retained from preceding resets?

options.label: A
options.text: They are surviving clones from prior reset cycles who staff the subterranean facilities and supervise the cloned children.
options.rationale: The specialized workforce includes human clones retained from preceding resets, and surviving clones from prior reset cycles help raise the children.

options.label: B
options.text: They are clones rejected for surface deployment because of genetic errors found during subterranean batch production.
options.rationale: Human clones retained from preceding resets are part of the specialized workforce, alongside 33rd-degree Freemasons and AI humanoid facsimiles.

options.label: C
options.text: They are the primary genetic templates from which every future surface clone in the batch is copied, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Templates are the genetic source created in batches of 5 to 10. Retained clones are workforce, not the templates themselves.

options.label: D
options.text: They are the elite leaders who dictate the timing of the next surface reset from inside the underground bases.
options.rationale: They are named as human clones retained from preceding resets within the specialized workforce that raises the cohorts.

questions.hint: Think about the experienced staff needed to raise new clones cycle after cycle.

questions.question: How is the Baseline Engineered Consensus established in the new population?

options.label: A
options.text: Baseline Engineered Consensus is established through ongoing military coercion and surveillance of the new surface population.
options.rationale: Societal consensus is established without requiring ongoing coercion because the cohort absorbs the installed narratives from childhood.

options.label: B
options.text: Baseline Engineered Consensus is established by genetically programming obedience into every cloned template before release.
options.rationale: Consensus comes from installed educational curricula and historical narratives absorbed from childhood, not from programmed genetic obedience.

options.label: C
options.text: The repopulating cohort absorbs installed educational curricula and historical narratives from childhood.
options.rationale: Because that absorption begins in childhood, societal consensus is established without requiring ongoing coercion.

options.label: D
options.text: Baseline Engineered Consensus is established through the collective trauma shared by every survivor of the surface reset.
options.rationale: The repopulating cohort absorbs installed educational curricula and historical narratives from childhood and did not live the prior events.

questions.hint: Consider the role of schools and stories in how a child understands the world.

questions.question: Which term describes the process where DNA from two cloned parents is randomly mixed?

options.label: A
options.text: Genetic Recombination is the natural biological process during sexual reproduction where DNA from two cloned parents is randomly mixed.
options.rationale: That mixing produces genetically unique offspring from cloned ancestry rather than further exact copies.

options.label: B
options.text: Temporal Alignment is the natural biological process during sexual reproduction where DNA from two cloned parents is randomly mixed.
options.rationale: A Temporal Doppelgänger is a historical lookalike. The mixing of DNA is genetic recombination.

options.label: C
options.text: Subterranean Gestation is the natural biological process during sexual reproduction where DNA from two cloned parents is randomly mixed.
options.rationale: Subterranean gestation is the underground rearing of the initial clones. Later DNA mixing is genetic recombination.

options.label: D
options.text: Narrative Inoculation is the natural biological process during sexual reproduction where DNA from two cloned parents is randomly mixed.
options.rationale: Narrative inoculation is psychological acceptance of installed cultural frameworks. The DNA mixing is genetic recombination.

questions.hint: Think of the biological term for shuffling genetic material.

questions.question: True or False: 33rd-degree Freemasons are individuals who aligned with the custodians in exchange for survival.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The subterranean facilities are staffed by an array of compromised personnel, including 33rd-degree Freemasons who traded alignment for survival.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: 33rd-degree Freemasons who traded alignment for survival are part of the specialized workforce inside the subterranean facilities.

questions.hint: Consider the compromise made by certain high-level groups to survive a reset.
